messages:
sana r.: quick intake — we're bringing up oceanus-6b (6B) as a candidate for general-purpose hosted and dedicated slots. asking for a concise bring-up + canary + fallback playbook. priorities: quality parity vs raven-13b int8 baseline, 95p latency <= 200ms for short prompts, and cost <= 0.6x raven. also need private deployment checklist (kms, audit logs). who wants to own this?

leo t.: assigning owners helps. i'll take rollout and canary orchestration (hosted/dedicated). @mike h. can you lead quant experiments & perf bench? @marisol g. QA + eval harness?

mike h.: yep i can. plan: run int8 and int4 experiments, measure LM-eval ppl, time per token, mem footprint, and end-to-end latency on a 2k token cap. will push artifact links to CI. main unknown: activation memory for 2x batch.

marisol g.: QA checklist start:
- eval suites: convo+cli-style prompts, long-context summarization, code completion (top-5).
- regression gates: >1% drop in exact-match or BLEU vs raven on critical sets -> block.
- automatic smoke: sample 200 prompts, compare top-1 token drift distribution.
- safety checks: prompt injection quick-stats.
I need dataset locations and owner for golden prompts.

eva (qa): add synthetic adversarial prompts (edge cases) and 50 customer examples from prod (redacted). i'll prepare. set threshold alerts for quality regressions in console.

sana r.: dataset: s3://redwood-evals/oceanus-golden/ (access-granted to eng-ml). timeline: int8 smoke by EOD Thu, canary next Tue if smoke passes.

leo t.: proposed staged canary + fallback: 
```
canary:
  step1: 0.5% traffic -> 30m smoke
  step2: 2% traffic -> 2h stability
  step3: 10% traffic -> 24h autoscale test
  step4: 25% traffic -> 48h full metrics
fallback_policy:
  metrics: {latency_95p: >220ms, error_rate: >0.5%, quality_drift: >1%}
  action: immediate rollback to raven-13b-int8
```
also warmup: prefill KV cache with top-10k prefixes during step1.

mike h.: for quant variants, name them: oceanus-6b-int8, oceanus-6b-int4, oceanus-6b-int4-ptq. i'll run HF quant scripts + our kernel selection patch. expected perf: int8 ~0.55x cost of raven, int4 TBD. will post perf matrix.

marisol g.: add canary probes: deterministic prompts and 30 random production samples. we need eval delta, token-level entropy shift, and a human-review bucket for flagged prompts. who owns the review queue?

sana r.: @marisol you own review queue. i'll add engineers from support for 12h rotation during step2 and step3.

ci-bot: perf artifacts uploaded -> https://ci.internal/redwood/oceanus6b/1955/artifacts (latency, profile flamegraphs, quant logs)

leo t.: important: dedicated/private differences:
- Dedicated: reserve capacity, increase canary duration, test autoscaler under commit (burst) conditions. verify GPU kernel fallbacks.
- Private: ensure KMS integration + HSM tested, image signing, and airgap deploy checklist (no outbound calls). keep fallback rule local: if model fails healthcheck, route to local raven-13b fallback instance.

deploy-bot: created rollout ticket RW-7623, linked to canary config. CI job rw-oceanus-canary triggered.

mike h.: note on warmup: run `python tools/prefill_kv.py --model oceanus-6b --prefixes s3://warmup/prefixes-10k.txt` before step1. that frees ~30ms on first token.

marisol g.: QA gating criteria summarized:
- unit tests: passes
- perf: lat95 <= 180ms on testbed
- quality: top-level eval delta <= 1% vs raven
- safety: no high-severity flags
If all green -> proceed to step1.

sana r.: timeline update: int8 smoke Wed, canary Thu 00:00 UTC, dedicated private validations Fri. owners: leo (rollout), mike (quant/perf), marisol+eva (QA), sana (product/coord). I'll circle back here after smoke run with artifacts. thanks all :thumbsup:
